items.title: NVIDIA Releases New AI Models and Developer Tools to Advance Autonomous Vehicle Ecosystem
items.summary: Autonomous vehicle (AV ) stacks are evolving from many distinct models to a unified, end-to-end architecture that executes driving actions directly from sensor data.
